title: The Basil Pack
description: Vanilla+ Modpack for The Basil Network's private modded server
body:
Vanilla+ Modpack made for the Basil Network private modded server

Inspired by [HazardousDaniel's Minecraft Unlimited](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/hazardousdaniels-unlimited), this modpack was made to bring about a version of Minecraft that restores the wonder and curiosity we had when we were kids. All areas of the game have been expanded, from automation to transportation, from world generation to structural exploration, from storage to farming, and more!

Includes:
- Create mod (and expansions) for upgraded automation
- Iron Chests & Shulkerboxes for expanded storage
- Quark for a wide array of additions (mod found here: [https://modrinth.com/mod/quark](https://modrinth.com/mod/quark))
- Team Abnormals mods for a variety of expansions (Upgrade Aquatic, Clayworks, Boatload)
- Continents, Tectonic, Biomes O' Plenty, and Nullscape for fresh world generation
- ChoiceTheorem's Overhauled Villages, YUNG's Better Suite, Better End Cities, and Moog's End Structures for more interesting exploration
- Farmer's Delight and Serene Seasons for enhanced farming
- The Aether (plus some expansions, like Ancient Aether & Aether: Redux) for a new dimension
- Snow! Real Magic! & Snow Under Trees for wonderful winters
- Naturalist, Friends & Foes, Realistic Horse Genetics, & Nyf's Spiders for a livlier creatures
- Another Furniture, Chipped, Sawmill, & more for beautiful new builds
- Aileron, Elytra Slot, Do a Barrel Roll, & Elytra Trims for reworked elytra
- Darceno's Minecart, Boatload, & Create Trains for fantastic transportation
- Embeddium & Radium for enhanced performance
- JEI for help with recipes! (And Configurable, found here: [https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/configured](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/configured) for ingame configuration)
- Few more mods for minor quality of life & experiential improvements

Full mod list is found under file dependencies
